translation_notes: no island opportunity at all: the region only builds two empty Graphs, parses one from a .ttl file and one from the Turtle text yatter generates at run time, and compares them with rdflib.compare.isomorphic. No RDF term is written in source, so translated.ldpy is the Python source verbatim (ldpy is a superset of Python) and equivalence is trivial
the expected mapping lives in mapping.ttl, i.e. in a data file rather than in code: this is the one shape of RDF-in-Python that ldpy has nothing to offer for

context (driver-side, identical for both representations): yatter is not installed in the venv, so the src/ directory of the corpus checkout citiususc/yatter@0b40dff623 is put on sys.path, and coloredlogs (imported by yatter only to colourise its logger) is replaced by a no-op stub module
data: mapping.ttl and mapping.yml (1.3 KB / 0.4 KB) copied from test/rml-star/YARRRMLTC-0028/ of the same checkout into the example directory, since the region reads them relative to its own __file__
